verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
YIMUKA-! ojje-eri Yesu
Akuli kumpi nnyo;
Oyatule-ebibi byo
Osenge Mukama

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Yimuka ojje! Yimuka ojje! akulindiridde:
Oyatul(e) ebibi byo,oweebwe n'omukisa
Gw'agabira obuwa; aweebw(e) ekitiibwa.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Yimuka-!ojje-eri Yesu
Va mu kizikiza:
Leka-okubuusabuusa,
Obudde buyita.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Yimuka-! ojje-eri Yesu
Akuli kumpi nnyo;
N'okuyita-akuyise
Anaakusonyiwa.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Yimuka-ojje-! eri Yesu
Jjangu,otidde ki?
Yafiirira-aboonoonyi:
Jjangu,omwesige.
